message: The other night, I was in the kitchen when the smoke alarm started blaring — turns out I was just a little too enthusiastic with the sautéing. In the chaos, my family group chat lit up with messages like "Is the house on fire?" and "Do we need to evacuate?" It was a little chaotic but also hilarious. We all had a good laugh and remembered how important it is to have a fire escape plan. Just a reminder that staying prepared can make even the most frantic moments a bit more manageable.
